steps.title: Harvest Algae Cells
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the algae culture at 2000xg for 10 min and remove the supernatant.

steps.title: Resuspend Cells in Lysis Buffer
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet in lysis buffer (50 mM Tris·HCL (pH 8.0), 0.1% Triton X-100) to achieve a 100-fold concentration of cells.

steps.title: Lyse Cells and Recover Proteins
steps.instruction: Sonicate the sample and centrifuge to isolate soluble proteins.

substeps.instruction: Sonicate using an appropriate sonication tip with the following settings: Duty cycle 0.5, Cycle 1.0 s, Amplitude 20%, and Duration 30 s.
Centrifuge for 15 min at 20000xg to remove cell debris.
Recover the soluble proteins and quantify the protein concentration.

steps.title: Perform SDS-PAGE and Transfer
steps.instruction: Separate proteins by electrophoresis and transfer them to a membrane.

substeps.instruction: Load 30 µg of total soluble protein (TSP) per lane onto a 12% SDS-PAGE gel.
Transfer proteins to a nitrocellulose membrane.

steps.title: Block and Probe Membrane
steps.instruction: Block the membrane and incubate with antibodies to detect the target protein.

substeps.instruction: Block the membrane with 5% milk solution.
Probe the desired protein with the specific antibody diluted in 5% milk solution.
Wash the membrane 2 times with TBST (0.2 M Tris, 1.37 M NaCl, 0.1% Tween-20, pH 7.6).
